# Horsehead Corporation: Leading Chemical Innovation

Horsehead Corporation, headquartered at 300 Frankfort Road in Monaca, Pennsylvania, stands as a prominent player in the specialty chemicals industry. With decades of operational experience, the company has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-quality chemical products and solutions serving diverse industrial sectors.

Located in the heart of Pennsylvania's chemical corridor, Horsehead Corporation benefits from strategic positioning near major transportation networks and industrial hubs, enabling efficient distribution and customer service across North America. The company's commitment to innovation and excellence has solidified its reputation as a trusted chemical manufacturer and supplier.

Horsehead Corporation specializes in the production of specialty chemicals, leveraging advanced manufacturing processes and technical expertise to meet the demanding requirements of customers in various industries, including metallurgy, environmental services, and industrial applications. The company's operations are characterized by adherence to strict quality standards and environmental compliance protocols.

The organization maintains a focus on sustainable practices and responsible chemical management, recognizing the importance of environmental stewardship in modern industrial operations. Through continuous investment in technology and workforce development, Horsehead Corporation remains positioned to deliver reliable products and services to its diverse customer base.

With a legacy of industrial excellence and forward-thinking business practices, Horsehead Corporation continues to be an integral part of Pennsylvania's chemical manufacturing landscape.
